<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="araxxor-basic-guide" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Araxxor - Basic Guide</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/w4CtXQCKIY.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Araxxor can be found in the Araxyte lair, just south of Port Phasmatys</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The fight can be done solo or duo (drop rates are reduced in duo)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Other guides: </nowiki><span><nowiki>#unknown-channel</nowiki></span></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-and-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics and Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following presets are based on Stage 1 </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki>:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=36ec3ebe-379d-4350-a3ff-ce7a88f7525a <nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/0cc0865639e485caeb034ef48e2806552c432364318e5947e42bbda880dd992c.webp" alt="Stage 1 - Magic Gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=50e03e24-37ad-4be8-abf5-a4bb22c0aa09 <nowiki>Ranged</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/d847e477c9dee750671dc663d939622012cd335757c2e454725cb7b72f3489be.webp" alt="Stage 1 - Ranged Gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=de7d0a00-3300-4607-ad6f-0c98f839c560 <nowiki>Melee</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/bf9d237f97d7548ffb0120ce1364f58961d674eb3aaf2da5c5e5d9505b8b0fc5.webp" alt="Stage 1 - Melee Gear" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918 <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>​
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F0d30907b-8f74-4b10-9335-335d98008918.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The fight consists of four phases: </nowiki><em><nowiki>Araxxor</nowiki></em><nowiki> in P1–3, followed by </nowiki><em><nowiki>Araxxi</nowiki></em><nowiki> in P4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ P2 has three possible paths:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Top/1 path (&quot;Minions&quot;)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Middle/2 path (&quot;Acid&quot;)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bottom/3 path (&quot;Darkness&quot;)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Only 2 of the 3 paths are open at any point, changing every 4 days</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can use the Beasts tab to view the current path rotation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You can change this at any time with </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/War's_Blessing_3 <nowiki>War's Blessing 3</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using Soul Split </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> slightly heals the boss when it hits you</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As enrage increases, as does damage from the below attack mechanics</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enrage increases by +20% per kill, to a maximum fight start of 300%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Enrage resets to 0% each day, or by using a pheromone </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643122483641188372.png?v=1" alt="pheromone" title="pheromone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at a bank</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="attack-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>P1–3: 5x auto → Random special attack → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Repeat</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Path mechanics happen during P2 depending on the open path:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Top Path: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Minion Spawn</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Middle Path: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Bomb Spider</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Bottom Path: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Spotlight</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>P4: Auto attacks → </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Putrid Wave</nowiki></strong><nowiki> at 25,000 LP</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="auto-attacks"><ins><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxor can spawn using Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks. This style is random in public instance, and based on your main-hand weapon in a private instance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Forcing an attack style</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If fighting Araxxor in a public instance, keep a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Araxyte_pheromone <nowiki>Araxyte pheromone</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643122483641188372.png?v=1" alt="pheromone" title="pheromone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> in your inventory</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Araxxor spawns in the style weak to your equipped main-hand style, e.g., it will deal Ranged damage if you are holding a sword</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once spawned, it will retain this attack style for the rest of the fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipping a necromancy weapon at time of spawn is random, as this style has no weakness</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against Araxxor's combat style if taking too much damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once you are comfortable surviving mechanics</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Be ready for a special attack after every 5 auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="cleave-example"><ins><nowiki>Cleave</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/A2rkoT1.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxor swipes in front of itself, dragging you into melee distance and dealing heavy typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stay away from Araxxor's front</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to prevent the drag</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If dragged in, move away quickly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="cocoon-example"><ins><nowiki>Cocoon</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/QfbT4nH.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxor traps you in a cocoon, dealing damage over time and stopping you from using defensives.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Spam-click to break free</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258240786434.png?v=1" alt="freedom" title="freedom" kind="icon" /><nowiki> reduce the number of clicks required</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="web-shield-example"><ins><nowiki>Web Shield</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/2gfprsH.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxor hides under a web, healing and reflecting damage back to you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stop attacking immediately</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to heal from one reflected hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="egg-bomb-example"><ins><nowiki>Egg Bomb</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/FXooXiP.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxor launches a slow bomb at you. If it does not hit the eggs, extra spiders spawn.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move onto the eggs so the bomb destroys them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move away after the explosion</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="top-path-minion-spawn-example"><ins><nowiki>(Top Path) Minion Spawn</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/J5SMqvv.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxor summons spiders. Some special spiders either reflect damage from Araxxor or heal Araxxor.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stop attacking Araxxor when spiders spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kill Mirrorback and Pulsing spiders first</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ignore or clear the other spiders as needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If unsure, wait for the special spider to spawn before attacking again</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="middle-path-bomb-spider-example"><ins><nowiki>(Middle Path) Bomb Spider</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/mYTxw9X.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> A bomb spider chases you and deals very high typeless damage if it reaches you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Run away until its timer expires</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="bottom-path-spotlight-example"><ins><nowiki>(Bottom Path) Spotlight</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/XXnmQsO.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> The arena becomes dark except for one safe light spot. Standing in the dark deals increasing typeless damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Move into the light</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to reach it quickly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="phase-4-araxxi-example"><ins><nowiki>Phase 4 - Araxxi</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki>[https://img.pvme.io/images/76WZHlY.gif <nowiki>(Example)</nowiki>]</h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Mechanic:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Araxxi attacks with Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> outside melee distance.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>At 25,000 LP, Araxxi spawns a bouncing black blob called Putrid Wave, which deals heavy damage over time.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Prayer flick </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at higher enrages</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
